items.source: Called after a session's tool index has been cleared — either because this strategy returned it from ToolIndexEvictionStrategy.onAccess(String), or because of an explicit eviction request.
items.translation: 在会话的工具索引被清除后调用——无论是因为该策略通过ToolIndexEvictionStrategy.onAccess(String)返回了它，还是因为显式的驱逐请求。

items.source: Called each time a session is accessed at the start of request processing.
items.translation: 每次在请求处理开始时访问会话时都会调用。

items.source: Access order is updated on every onAccess(String) call, so a session that receives a new request is moved to the most-recently-used position and will not be a candidate for eviction until all other sessions have been accessed.
items.translation: 访问顺序会在每次调用 onAccess(String) 时进行更新，因此接收到新请求的会话会被移至最近使用的位置，并且只有在所有其他会话都被访问后，该会话才会成为被驱逐的候选对象。

items.source: Implementations should update their internal tracking state for sessionId and return the set of session IDs whose tool indexes must now be cleared. The returned set must never include the currently-accessed sessionId.
items.translation: 实现应更新其内部跟踪状态以处理sessionId，并返回必须清除工具索引的会话 ID 集合。该返回集合绝不能包含当前正在访问的sessionId。

items.source:
This strategy is suitable for remote vector databases and API-based embedding models,
where the number of sessions whose embeddings are retained in the store must be
bounded.
items.translation: 该策略适用于远程向量数据库和基于 API 的嵌入模型，其中必须对存储在其中的会话嵌入数量进行限制。

items.source: Implementations should remove any internal tracking state for the evicted session.
items.translation: 实现应移除被驱逐会话的任何内部跟踪状态。

items.source: maxSessions - maximum number of sessions whose indexes are retained; must be positive
items.translation: maxSessions - 保留的会话索引的最大数量；必须为正数。

items.source: session IDs to evict; never null, may be empty
items.translation: 待驱逐的会话 ID；永远不会为null，可能为空。

items.source: A ToolIndexEvictionStrategy that evicts the least-recently-used session when the number of concurrently active sessions exceeds a configured maximum.
items.translation: 一个 ToolIndexEvictionStrategy，当并发活跃会话数超过配置的最大限度时，它会驱逐最近最少使用的会话。
